I read this as repository exploration - I’ll trace the presentation surfaces, realtime transports, slide-state ownership/mutations, and all media/WebRTC code with exact file-and-line evidence.

<analysis>
**Literal Request**: Produce a read-only, line-numbered map of how presentations are rendered and controlled across `apps/stage`, `apps/console`, and `private-backend`, including every realtime transport and any video/media/WebRTC implementation.
**Actual Need**: Establish the current end-to-end live-presentation architecture and identify concrete integration points and authority boundaries without relying on filenames or assumptions.
**Success Looks Like**: A complete set of absolute paths, exact quoted channel-establishment and slide-mutation lines, plus a direct explanation of what stage renders, what console exposes, how state moves, who may mutate it, and whether media streaming exists.
</analysis>

I read this as architecture mapping - I traced the active UI, state mutations, and transport endpoints with source evidence. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/App.tsx - Stage display setup, subscriptions, snapshot application, local keyboard navigation, and slide/card rendering. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/stage-client.ts - Stage REST, SSE, and WebSocket clients; public deck image extraction. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/windows-topology.ts - Emergency keyboard-to-public-slide command mapping. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/App.tsx - Current presenter-facing Console routes and live-candidate approval UI. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/session-client.ts - Console-to-private-backend REST client; confirms missing playback transport. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/audio-capture.tsx - Audio-only `MediaStream` capture implementation. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/http.ts - Private REST API, controller SSE endpoint, and slide-set mutation endpoint. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/prepared-evidence.ts - Presentation creation, active playback lease authorization, authoritative slide mutation, and projection dispatch. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/projection-http-port.ts - Private-backend-to-projection-gateway HTTP transport. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/prepared-deck-upload.ts - Current synthetic private/public deck artifact generation. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/http.ts - Stage SSE and snapshot endpoints plus internal playback ingestion. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/main.ts - WebSocket upgrade and gateway-to-private-backend receipt transport. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/realtime.ts - WebSocket authentication, delivery, and receipt protocol. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/prepared-evidence.ts - Public projection occurrence state and realtime fan-out. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/packages/state/src/playback.ts - Canonical playback reducer and occurrence mutation. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/tests/e2e/windows-topology.harness.ts - Test-only canvas `MediaRecorder` usage, not product presentation transport. - /C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/docs/PWA-구현-최적화-연구보고서.html - Documentation-only WebRTC mention, explicitly deferred. ### 1. What Stage actually renders Stage first creates a display join using a generated display identity and a deck version from `?deck=`: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/App.tsx:55-71` ```ts const deckVersion = new URL(window.location.href).searchParams.get("deck") ?? "deck_alpha"; ... void client .createJoin(identity, deckVersion) ``` After approval, it subscribes before fetching the authoritative snapshot: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/App.tsx:629-638` ```ts if (client.subscribeRealtime !== undefined) { if (sseSubscription === null) sseSubscription = await client.subscribe(observer); } else { subscription = await client.subscribe(observer); } ... const next = await client.snapshot(pins); ``` Public deck artifacts are consumed from `snapshot.deck.slides`. Each `image.url` becomes `imageUrl`: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/stage-client.ts:221-240` ```ts for (const valueSlide of deck.slides) { const slide = record(valueSlide); const image = record(slide?.image); ... deckSlides.push({ publicSlideKey: slide.publicSlideKey, ordinal: slide.ordinal, imageUrl: image.url, imageContentHash: image.contentHash, accessibilityLabel: slide.accessibilityLabel, }); } ``` The current occurrence selects the image, which is rendered as an ordinary ``: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/App.tsx:781-812` ```ts const currentSlide = snapshot?.deckSlides.find( (slide) => slide.publicSlideKey === snapshot.occurrence.publicSlideKey, ); ... ``` Stage also renders one approved evidence card's claim, source label, and support summary at `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/App.tsx:816-830`. Current prepared-deck generation is synthetic and single-slide: the backend accepts title/content and emits a public PNG URL without rendering or uploading that PNG: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/prepared-deck-upload.ts:34-50` ```ts publicDeck: PublishedDeckArtifactSchema.parse({ ... slides: [ { ... image: { url: `https://public.example.test/slides/${imageHash}.png`, contentHash: imageHash, width: 1920, height: 1080, }, ``` ### 2. What Console shows the presenter today The authenticated Console currently exposes: - Room overview and display-boundary guidance. - Session setup checklist. - Microphone-consent panel. - Live candidate lookup by presentation-session ID. - Candidate claim/evidence/slide occurrence and explicit “Approve live card” action. Routes are defined at `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/App.tsx:449-464`: ```ts } /> } /> } /> ``` Live candidate details are rendered at `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/App.tsx:390-406`: ```ts

{candidate.evidenceExcerpt}

{candidate.occurrence.publicSlideKey} / occurrence {candidate.occurrence.occurrenceSeq}

... Approve live card ``` Important current limitation: Console has no wired display-binding, playback-controller, lease-takeover, or slide-set UI/client method. Searches found no use of those endpoints in `apps/console`. Although `createPresentation()` exists in the client at `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/session-client.ts:236-245`, the current UI does not call it. ### 3. Transport and every realtime channel #### Console to private backend Console uses ordinary credentialed `fetch`, not realtime transport. Examples: - Sign-in: `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/session-client.ts:160-165` - Candidate snapshot: `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/session-client.ts:199-203` - Approval: `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/session-client.ts:211-226` - Presentation creation: `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/session-client.ts:236-242` #### Private backend controller SSE The private backend offers an authenticated controller SSE endpoint: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/http.ts:228-239` ```ts if (request.method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/v1/playback/controller-events") { ... : controllerEventStream( dependencies.coordinator, accountSessionId, presentationSessionId, ``` It establishes a `ReadableStream` and marks it SSE: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/http.ts:91-123` ```ts const body = new ReadableStream({ start(controller) { const connected = coordinator.connectPlaybackController( ... headers.set("content-type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8"); ``` Today `apps/console` never creates an `EventSource` or calls this endpoint, so this server channel exists but is not established by the shipped Console UI. #### Private backend to projection gateway This is authenticated server-to-server HTTP POST, not realtime socket transport: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/projection-http-port.ts:33-41` ```ts return fetch(`${this.#baseUrl}${path}`, { method: "POST", headers: { authorization: this.#authorization, "content-type": "application/json", ``` Playback uses `/internal/playback`: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/projection-http-port.ts:76-88` ```ts return (await this.#post("/internal/playback", { presentationSessionId, event })).ok; ``` #### Stage SSE Stage establishes SSE at: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/stage-client.ts:577,627` ```ts eventSourceFactory: EventSourceFactory = (url) => new EventSource(url), ... const source = eventSourceFactory(`${baseUrl}/v1/events`); ``` Gateway serves it at: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/http.ts:534-540` ```ts if (request.method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/v1/events") { ... return eventStream(dependencies, audienceDisplaySessionId, origin); } ``` The exact SSE response setup is: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/http.ts:306-334` ```ts const body = new ReadableStream({ start(controller) { ... socket = dependencies.gateway.connectStage( ... headers.set("content-type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8"); headers.set("connection", "keep-alive"); ``` #### Stage WebSocket Stage establishes WebSocket realtime after the initial SSE subscription and snapshot: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/stage-client.ts:676-682` ```ts const realtimeUrl = new URL( `${baseUrl}/v1/realtime`, globalThis.location?.href ?? "http://localhost/", ); realtimeUrl.protocol = realtimeUrl.protocol === "https:" ? "wss:" : "ws:"; const source = webSocketFactory(realtimeUrl.href); ``` Gateway upgrades `/v1/realtime`: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/main.ts:86-106` ```ts if (new URL(request.url).pathname !== "/v1/realtime") return httpHandler(request); ... return server.upgrade(request, { ... websocket: { open(socket) { socket.data.connection = realtime.connect( ``` Playback/card delivery is fan-out through the gateway’s in-memory Stage socket observers: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/prepared-evidence.ts:910-912` ```ts for (const socket of this.#sockets.get(presentationSessionId) ?? []) { if (!socket.closed) socket.observer.onPlayback(delivered); } ``` WebSocket receipt frames return to private backend through HTTP: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/main.ts:53-61` ```ts const response = await fetch(`${privateBackendOrigin}/internal/stage-applied`, { method: "POST", headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${internalAuthToken}`, ``` #### Polling and BroadcastChannel No `setInterval` polling or `BroadcastChannel` exists in application/service source. Stage performs one-shot snapshot fetches on initial connection and reconnect: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/stage-client.ts:612` ```ts const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/v1/snapshot${suffix}`, { ``` Console candidate refresh is user-triggered, not polling. `MessageChannel` exists only for service-worker update coordination and is unrelated to presentation transport. ### 4. Current-slide state and mutation authority The private backend owns canonical controller state in each presentation’s `playback`. Initial state is the first public slide: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/prepared-evidence.ts:545-554` ```ts const playback = createPlaybackAuthorityState({ ... slideOrder: publicDeck.data.slides.map((slide) => slide.publicSlideKey), initialSlideKey: firstSlide.publicSlideKey, }); ``` Reducer initialization is: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/packages/state/src/playback.ts:563-564` ```ts occurrence: { publicSlideKey: input.initialSlideKey, occurrenceSeq: 1 }, nextOccurrenceSeq: 2, ``` The mutation endpoint is: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/http.ts:354-365` ```ts if (request.method === "POST" && url.pathname === "/v1/playback/slide-set") { const result = await dependencies.coordinator.setSlide( accountSessionId, { ... publicSlideKey: String(body.publicSlideKey ?? ""), ``` Only the authenticated account actor holding the active playback lease may change it: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/prepared-evidence.ts:738-749` ```ts const account = this.readAccountSession(accountSessionId, nowMs); if ( account.outcome === "REJECTED" || account.value.actorId !== authorized.value.playback.activeLease.actorId ) { return { outcome: "REJECTED", reason: "UNAUTHORIZED" }; } ``` The reducer additionally enforces actor, session epoch, lease, expiry, controller epoch, display binding, and base revision at `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/packages/state/src/playback.ts:657-690`. Exact canonical mutation: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/packages/state/src/playback.ts:707-712,736-747` ```ts const occurrence = slideChanged ? { publicSlideKey: nextSlide, occurrenceSeq: state.nextOccurrenceSeq } : state.occurrence; const nextOccurrenceSeq = slideChanged ? state.nextOccurrenceSeq + 1 : state.nextOccurrenceSeq; ... state: { ...state, controlRevision: acceptedControlRevision, occurrence, nextOccurrenceSeq, ``` The coordinator commits that reduction and sends it to projection: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/private-backend/src/prepared-evidence.ts:782-792` ```ts authorized.value.playback = reduction.state; if ( !(await this.#projection.projectPlayback(input.presentationSessionId, { ... occurrence: reduction.effect.occurrence, ... authorized.value.playback = playback; ``` Gateway’s public copy mutates here: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/services/projection-gateway/src/prepared-evidence.ts:908-909` ```ts projection.occurrence = event.occurrence; projection.blackout = event.blackout; ``` Stage applies delivered playback to local React state: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/App.tsx:487-495` ```ts const next = { ...current, publicPlaybackRevision: event.publicPlaybackRevision, occurrence: event.occurrence, blackout: event.blackout, }; ``` There is also an unauthenticated-to-backend, local-only Stage keyboard fallback. It changes only Stage React state and never calls `/v1/playback/slide-set`: - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/App.tsx:730-746` ```ts const occurrence = { publicSlideKey: target.publicSlideKey, occurrenceSeq: current.occurrence.occurrenceSeq + 1, }; ... return { ...current, occurrence }; ``` - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/stage/src/App.tsx:759-770` ```ts setSnapshot((current) => ... { ...current, occurrence: { publicSlideKey: command.publicSlideKey, occurrenceSeq: current.occurrence.occurrenceSeq + 1, }, ``` Thus the authoritative changer is the active leased presenter actor through private backend. Any Stage operator can locally move the displayed cached image with keyboard input, but this does not update authoritative playback state and can be overwritten by the next snapshot/realtime command. ### 5. Video, media stream, and WebRTC Product code contains one media-stream feature: microphone-only capture. - `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/audio-capture.tsx:56` ```ts const stream = await this.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true, video: false }); ``` Tracks are explicitly stopped at `/C:/Users/steve/Desktop/projects/impromptu-r2/apps/console/src/audio-capture.tsx:183-184`. However, the current `SessionPage` supplies neither a `BrowserCaptureController` nor `requestGrant`, so the microphone button is disabled by the component’s own condition at lines 161-162. The capture abstraction exists but is not operationally wired to an uploader in the current Console route. There is: - No product ` The immediate integration gap is clear: the backend already exposes display approval, controller SSE, lease takeover, and slide-set authority, but the current Console client/UI wires none of them. Implementing presenter-controlled advancement requires adding those client methods and UI while retaining the backend’s active-lease and revision checks. Ready to proceed - no follow-up needed.
